questions.question: What should I do first?
questions.answer: Start with a small action you want to repeat and attach it to an existing routine. I can help plan an optional experiment, but this chat cannot save a habit.

questions.question: How does Routiq work?
questions.answer: Routiq is designed to help you plan habits, record activity, review progress and explore improvements. This Coach currently provides general advice; personal records are not connected.

questions.question: Can you help me start a routine?
questions.answer: Tell me the routine you want to build and an existing activity that could serve as a cue. We can explore a manageable starting action.

questions.question: What habits should I track first?
questions.answer: Choose a habit that matters to you and fits your circumstances, such as reading after a regular daily activity. I cannot select habits from a personal profile here.

questions.question: How many habits should I start with?
questions.answer: Start with a manageable set of habits rather than changing everything at once. I cannot prescribe a personalized count or an unapproved Routiq limit.

questions.question: Where do I see my habits?
questions.answer: In the approved design, Today shows scheduled habits and Habit Detail focuses on an individual habit. This notebook does not retrieve your saved habits.

questions.question: How do I check off a habit?
questions.answer: The approved prototype illustrates marking a habit complete from Today. This Coach cannot save completions, and a prototype interaction does not confirm a real record.

questions.question: What can you help me with?
questions.answer: I can discuss general habit ideas, routines and optional experiments. Personal progress, habit changes and saved conversation memory are not connected yet.

questions.question: Do I have enough data for insights?
questions.answer: I cannot assess your history because it is not connected. Minimum-data rules for insights are also still TBD_PRODUCT_DECISION.

questions.question: What should I focus on today?
questions.answer: Choose a manageable action that matters to you. I cannot prioritize your actual scheduled habits without access to your Today records.

questions.question: What do I have to do today?
questions.answer: I cannot list your actual activities for today because your habit schedules are not connected.

questions.question: Show my habits for today.
questions.answer: Your Today habit list is not available to this Coach yet. The Today screen exists in the approved design, not as a connected notebook feature.

questions.question: Which habits are scheduled today?
questions.answer: I need verified schedules to identify which habits are due today; those schedules are not connected here.

questions.question: What have I finished today?
questions.answer: I cannot confirm what you finished today without saved completion records.

questions.question: What is still pending?
questions.answer: I cannot list pending habits without both your schedule and recorded activity statuses.

questions.question: How much of today is complete?
questions.answer: Today's completion rate needs verified scheduled and completed activities and an approved denominator rule. I cannot calculate it here.

questions.question: Am I done for today?
questions.answer: I cannot confirm that you are done for today without your full verified schedule and completion records.

questions.question: What should I tackle next?

questions.answer: Whether a habit can be created without a reminder is not confirmed for production. I will not assume reminders are mandatory or optional.
